intent: A single typed value bindable to a named sqlite3 prepared-statement parameter, with wire-safe serialize/deserialize so bound parameters can travel inside an SData header value.

objects.name: SQliteParameter
objects.role: Type enum class (Null/Int64/Double/Text/Blob), public value fields, static factories, serialize/deserialize, and param-name URI encode/decode

location_fit.note: sits with the other SQLite-adjacent S-types (SQResult, SQValue) in libstuff
